\begin{rSection}{Research Profile}
I am an NRF Postdoctoral Fellow in Computer Science at the National University of Singapore. My research bridges divides across data, models, and people to solve real-world problems. I develop trustworthy AI systems spanning federated learning, machine unlearning, multi-agent systems, and the two-way relationship between AI and psychology. My work has appeared in ICLR, NeurIPS, SIGMOD, ACL, KDD, and related venues, including two ICLR 2026 Oral papers and a SIGMOD 2023 Honorable Mention for Best Artifact. My work has received 3000+ citations on Google Scholar. I serve as an Area Chair (AC) for premier machine learning conferences such as ICLR.
\end{rSection}
